registryOwner: The complete original ordered emission, including paged child collection and all artifact/config/window-config lanes, remains unique in one registry cell.
ledgerLeaf: Exactly one scalar retained-emission identity per accepted tick or commit. ScrubLedger clones its scalar authority, never source or typed emission owners.
absoluteSemantics: Every tick replaces the complete absolute emission. Preview borrows the accepted identity and visits its original lanes in their declared order. It neither rebuilds child sources nor clones them.
commit: Extract the complete original emission for every committed identity before reconciling against the now-empty accepted ledger. The returned transaction stamps the same original owning emission.
refusal: Any incomplete preparation or canceled admission preserves the incoming whole owner; any scalar-ledger refusal preserves the actually restored ledger and retains the staged registry owner until accepted-ledger absence permits explicit retirement.
emptyPublication: The original empty children remain owned even when the whole emission's published child selection is empty. No absence of wire output implies absence of semantic/source ownership.
outerCollections: One scalar ledger leaf avoids materializing an unbounded Vec of child identities. Actual child/source/label/publication outer ownership remains paged.
remaining: Every typed artifact/config/window-config mutation and delta owner still needs real bounded closure. This source design grants no exemption for contiguous typed String ownership and no credit for global required OpBinary decoder/canonical scaffolds.
